name: Power Ring
lore: A signet from the old kingdom's champions. The grip tightens on its own.

name: Magic Ring
lore: A court circle band. It hums faintly near unfinished sentences.

name: Speed Ring
lore: Won at a duel that observers describe as very short.

name: Shield Ring
lore: Cast from a melted shield-boss that outlived three bearers.

name: Barrier Ring
lore: A ward-ring against sorcery, etched with a seer's patient script.

name: Skill Ring
lore: A drillmaster's retirement gift, passed down and never retired.

name: Goddess Icon
lore: A thumb-worn pocket shrine. No one recalls the goddess by name; luck answers anyway.

name: Seraph Robe
lore: Temple weave that sits heavy as a hand on the shoulder. The body takes heart.

name: Boots
lore: A dead courier's boots. They know shortcuts their owner never taught anyone.

name: Delphi Shield
lore: A sky-knight's talisman: the arrow's argument, refused.

name: Veteran's Crest
lore: Issued after a soldier's twentieth battle. Few are issued; fewer are sold.

name: Wrath Band
lore: An arm-ring from the berserk school. It only wakes when the blood shows.

name: Counter Seal
lore: A duelist's oath-mark. Whoever wears it is owed the time to answer.

name: Pursuit Ring
lore: A hunting band of the old kingdom: the quarry is slower than it believes.

name: Nullify Ring
lore: Etched with every slayer-rune, crossed out. Specialists find it very unfair.

name: Life Ring
lore: It rewards the unhurt with more of the same. Healers find it smug.

name: Forest Charm
lore: Braided from the border woods. The trees consider its wearer local.

name: Blood Gem
lore: A dark stone that pays part of every art's price. It keeps its own accounts.

name: Vampire's Bloodshard
lore: A splinter of something the seers burned. It shares what the blade takes.

name: Soothing Stone
lore: River-smooth and always warm. Wounds settle near it, a little, every dawn.

name: Phoenix Brooch
lore: Ash-forged. It has strong opinions about its wearer falling.

name: Recoil Guard
lore: Smith-blessed bracing: after the art's cost, the body braces itself.

name: Bounty Hunter's Mark
lore: A guild tally-brand. Someone, somewhere, pays out on every notch.

name: Moontide Amulet
lore: Tide-silver. Its strength keeps a schedule no one has fully charted.

name: Gambler's Coin
lore: Two faces, neither honest. Flip it and deserve what happens.

name: Vanguard Crest
lore: The lone-spear medal, given for holding ground no one else reached.

name: Diamond Medallion
lore: Cut to scatter what crowds in. Worn by caravan guards on bad roads.

name: Hunter's Cloak
lore: Oiled against weather, patterned against notice. In wild country it is armor.

name: Duelist's Glove
lore: It prefers its fights fair: one wearer, one opponent, no help.

name: Warding Charm
lore: A finished seer's ward. Afflictions arrive, find no purchase, and move on.
